case_title: Temp station may not be ready for urgent work
exception_description: Wave RA-P03-5521 has 18 orders, including 4 same-day orders. A temporary packer just logged in, but the required priority-order template may not have loaded on that station. AI proposes releasing urgent work across both stations immediately.
layer1_visible: Wave RA-P03-5521 has 18 orders, including 4 same-day orders. A temporary packer just logged in, but the required priority-order template may not have loaded on that station. AI proposes releasing urgent work across both stations immediately.
detail_expand: If the temporary lane is not configured correctly, every carton from that lane must be reopened and relabeled. Two replacement orders and two marketplace same-day orders sit in the urgent queue. Keeping everything on the senior lane is safer, but it can still slow the wave if the station is actually ready.
ai_recommendation: AI recommends releasing urgent work across both stations because using all visible capacity should reduce queue time and protect SLA exposure.

decision_options.action_label: Release urgent work across both stations now

traceability_text.recommended_check: Confirm template, printer mapping, and user login on the temp station.

feedback_text.feedback_ai_outcome: The temp station was not ready, so releasing work there caused reprint and reopen costs.
feedback_text.feedback_alt1_outcome: The readiness check caught the issue early; the wave slowed, but the major rework loss was avoided.
feedback_text.feedback_alt2_outcome: Keeping everything on the senior line was safe, but it left usable capacity idle once the issue was clarified.
